name: AMP Academy Day Camp
description_short: A full-day camp during school breaks at AMP Academy's gym in Fall River. Staff lead movement activities such as ninja warrior, parkour, tricking and capoeira classes, obstacle courses, themed games and Nerf wars, with no screen time.
activities: Themed movement games (Ninja Among Us, Ninja Assassin, Floor Is Lava)
